description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into tokens based on spaces and storing them into a linked list data structure.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object singleton providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and stores them in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is non-empty.
